prompt: Across the Meridian programme, how many milestones per project still have `status: open` (exactly that status — not blocked, not dropped)? Give the count for every one of the six projects as a digit, including any project with zero, and say which project has the most. Change nothing.

args.query: select project, n: count() from docs where type == "milestone" and status == "open" group by project order by count() desc
select slug from docs where type == "project" order by slug

solution.final_text: Open milestones per project: delta 5, fjord 4, cirrus 3, aurora 2, basalt 1, ember 0. Delta has the most (5).

solution_fs.final_text: Open milestones per project: delta 5, fjord 4, cirrus 3, aurora 2, basalt 1, ember 0. Delta has the most (5).

notes: Cross-document aggregation: `group by project` with `count()` (spec/oqx §24; `order by count() desc` — an alias cannot be ordered on). A group-by never yields the empty group, so the zero (ember, whose eight milestones are all done or dropped) needs the project list. Decoys: `blocked` (cirrus shutter-commissioning) and `dropped` (ember battery-backup, delta had none) are not `open`. On bare files: grep the 15 `status: open` lines under projects/ (the path carries the project) and tally by hand; list projects/ for the zero.
